generated_by: the B4 latency measurement in this session
concurrency: five seats speak concurrently within a round
superseded_by: the Phase D performance work; the numbers below were re-measured

phase_d_remeasurement.problem: Every seat was handed the ENTIRE transcript every round, so the prompt and the wall clock both grew with the debate.
phase_d_remeasurement.diagnosis: Five seats re-processing 1776 tokens is roughly 9k tokens of prompt work per round, compounding every round. Ollama also caps real concurrency at about 3x rather than 5x, measured: a single call takes 1.2s alone and up to 5.2s when five run together.
phase_d_remeasurement.fix: History is windowed. The previous round is given in full; older turns are clipped to 160 characters, capped at 10 of them, with any omission declared in the prompt. The Facilitator's round-0 turn — which carries the question and the stage rules — is always kept.
phase_d_remeasurement.result: 126.5s -> 60.9s for three rounds, a 2.1x speedup, and the prompt now settles instead of growing.
phase_d_remeasurement.also_added: keep_alive on the chat model so retrieval does not evict it between rounds, and a startup warm-up so the first round of a session does not pay a cold load.
